b_quantities.per_card: aifoundry1 card 1 at 600 MHz (not governed); aifoundry1 card 0 low power under its governor (main band 800 MHz)
b_quantities.T1_wall: cycles an op, the slowest minion: forecast cycles_per_op_wall / cyc_op_max - 1
b_quantities.T2_counter_mean: the counter's mean cycles an op: forecast cycles_per_op_mean / cyc_op_mean - 1
b_quantities.T3_seconds: seconds a GEMM: ops x T_forecast(us) x 1e-6 / t_pass_s - 1 (ops = 64 MB NB KB a minion); at the measured clock T3's error equals T1's identically (the reducer's T_op_us = wall / ops): both printed
b_quantities.E1_J_over_idle_given_t: W over idle at the measured op time: W = A + B / t_meas (the predictor's W_affine at the run's conditions) against the primary view's dP_w; relative (= J over idle given t) when the case's mean MM1-v3.1 W given t and its mean measured dP_w are both 3 W or more; else a WATTS case, scored by the mean of its runs' W - dP_w in watts (E215's form; the watts set fixed by MM1-v3.1 and the measurement, the same for every model)
b_quantities.E2_J_over_idle_t_forecast: (W_fc x T_fc) / (dP_w x t_meas) - 1, W_fc the W over idle at the model's own op time T_fc; at a watts case W_fc - dP_w
b_quantities.E3_J_at_rest_given_t: (P_rest + W given t) / (P_rest + dP_w) - 1, P_rest = p_mean_w - dP_w (the run's rest, measured, given)
b_quantities.E4_J_at_rest_t_forecast: (P_rest + W_fc) x T_fc / ((P_rest + dP_w) x t_meas) - 1
b_quantities.split: per card; per format and kind; the 1x1x1 cells (X1) and the new core-group masks (MG) apart (also SUB, FULL); groups S, C, K; configuration twins apart

forecast_procedure.footing_1_measured: THE PRIMARY FOOTING: each frozen predictor unchanged at each run's measured conditions, read from the data's start-of-run records only, MM1-v3 README section 5's form as unread-e214 did: the primary view's kernel clock kclock_mhz; minion volts: card 1 the models' footing 0.517 V, card 0 the primary view's rails.minion.mV / 1000 (else the model's own volts at f); the governed base by the model's own G_of_f(card, f); the run's die_start_c (50 C when absent). The terms and controls on MM1-v3.1's forecast at the same conditions; the layout features are configuration-only (made at step 2w).
forecast_procedure.fields_read_before_scoring: from each committed E217 data JSON ONLY: the top-level card, session and primary_view, and per run: run, i, ran, role, arm, values, type, shires, minions, die_start_c, and the primary view's kclock_mhz and rails.minion.mV. No time, cycles, power, energy or seconds field is read until the forecasts at those conditions are hashed.
forecast_procedure.footing_2_nominal: the nominal forecasts frozen now (section h), scored beside by the same rules (REPORTED beside the primary footing)
forecast_procedure.counts_as_inputs: the switch counts are inputs, never fitted: MM1-v3.1's tables (MM1-v3's rows + counts 3e8991d0); counts-e214's land (4c39d0d3; E217 reuses none of its 20 tiles: none added); counts-e217 for E217's 21 new kinds, made in step 4 from the tile files alone (rtl-sim/fma_toggle_v2, Verilator 5.042, counts-e214's form) and frozen (COUNTS-FROZEN.txt) before any E217 measurement is read; added in memory to each model's tables by its own loop (no key colliding: asserted), unread-e214's form
forecast_procedure.order: 1 this declaration hashed -> 2 the nominal forecasts hashed -> FROZEN.txt -> 4 counts-e217 -> COUNTS-FROZEN.txt; then, after the data: the conditions read -> the measured-conditions forecasts hashed -> the scorer hashed -> the read and the scores

c_metric.error: forecast / measured - 1 (the MM1 convention); rms % and signed mean (bias) %; watts cases rms and mean in W
c_metric.case: a case's error = the mean of its runs' errors (each run at its own conditions); per-run figures REPORTED beside
c_metric.twins: per model: a time case is a twin when (card, kernel, arm, format, mask, the mean of its runs' measured clocks to 25 MHz) is in that model's TRAINING time configurations (its landed out/points_time_*.csv, E146 store rungs out); an energy case when that key and its energy kind are in its energy configurations (work/step1/twin-keys.json, 3418b7d8, equal to unread-e214's). The no-twin cases carry the pass rule and the headline; twins and all cases printed beside. At the nominal clocks: MM1-v3.1 63 time-twin and 24 energy-twin cases of 486 (a preview; the measured clock decides)

d_comparisons.test: the exact two-sided sign test (binomial at 1/2) on the untied cases, alpha 0.05: A BETTER if p < 0.05 and A is closer in more cases; B BETTER the other way; NOT DECIDED otherwise; TOO FEW under 10 untied cases; NO DATA with none
d_comparisons.d: per case, d = |ln(1 + e_B)| - |ln(1 + e_A)| for the pair (A vs B) (A closer when d > tie); at a watts case |dW_B| - |dW_A| in W; over every case both price (twins included); REPORTED beside over the cases that are twins for neither
d_comparisons.ties_how: E215's rule (rules_e215.ties_of), unread-e214's values: card 1 E215 arm B's registered ties; card 0 from E212 a1c0-S1/S2's pooled within-case spread (bands.json card0_floors)
d_comparisons.D1_v31_vs_v3: MM1-v3.1 vs MM1-v3 on H1 wall, H2 counter mean, H3 seconds, H4 J over idle given t (E1), H5 J over idle with t forecast (E2): per card and pooled
d_comparisons.D2_v31_vs_v2: MM1-v3.1 vs MM1-v2 on H1-H5: per card and pooled
d_comparisons.D3_layout: on the subset-mask cases (MG and SUB), per card and pooled: 'v3.1+contention' vs MM1-v3.1, and each control (N1+N2, G1, G1+N1, the layout-blind F1) vs MM1-v3.1, on H1 (wall) and H2 (counter mean); the MG cases alone and 'v3.1+contention' vs each control REPORTED beside; H5 (J over idle with t forecast) REPORTED
d_comparisons.D4_switch: on group S: MM1-v3.1 with counts-e217 vs the null N, Q1 and Q2 (section e): part S's P2 and P4
d_comparisons.verdicts: each comparison is a verdict of its own, never part of PASS

e_switch.gate: DECLARED (before any datum, from the tile files alone): the fp32 tiles gt125, gt25, gt875 and the fp16 tile h_gt25 hold all-zero A rows (13, 10, 2 and 12 of 16), B none: their float gate is the arow form at the tile's own all-zero-row share, (g_op, g_lane, g8) = (share, 0, 0) - E210's arow50 (0.5, 0, 0) and E214's sp_ar4 declaration (unread-e214) - in MM1-v3.1's and MM1-v3's gate_shares; every other new float kind has no zero element: (0, 0, 0), the frozen code's literal; int8 kinds the frozen code's own 1 - v (v the count's valid share). The literal (0, 0, 0) for the four zero-row tiles REPORTED beside; the count's valid share REPORTED beside each declared share.
e_switch.sparse50: pattern:sparse50f / h / i priced as the committed sparse50 kind (data_v31.SPARSE_GEN plus sparse50h, unread-e214's alias); group C REPORTED
e_switch.Q1: group S, W over idle given t: MM1-v3.1 + the counts against the null N = the mean over zeros, ones and random of the run's format of the same model's own W given t at the run's conditions (the same base; only the count's information differs); cases with dP_w >= 3 W
e_switch.Q2: group S, E210's metric, the share of D: e_D = [(W_fc(P) - W_fc(R)) - (W_P - W_R)] / D, D = W_R - W_Z measured, R and Z the random and zeros cases of the same card, arm, format and mask (measured means; W_fc(R) the same model's W given t, its runs' mean); for the null [(N(P) - W_fc(R)) - (W_P - W_R)] / D; cases with an R and a Z case and D > 0
e_switch.N2_REPORTED: the null over ones and random only
e_switch.MM1-v3_REPORTED: the same with MM1-v3 + the counts

f_pass_rule.bands_how: E215's form (rules_e215.py, unchanged; unread-e214's s01d_bands.py re-run here): 2 x max(B1, B2) rounded up to a whole percent, B1 MM1-v3.1's LOEO no-twin error over every point, B2 over this card's points (holdout_v31.json reproduced first); T3 takes T1's bases; watts band 2 x max(B1 W, B2 W, SD_rep) rounded up to 0.01 W. Card 1's equal E215 arm B's registered bands (checked).
f_pass_rule.part_A: MM1-v3.1 on the PRIMARY footing by E215's rule form on each card over the NO-TWIN cases: a case passes T1, T2, T3, E3, E4 when |error| is within the band, E1, E2 when |error| is within the band or, at a watts case, |watts difference| within the watts band; a rule PASSES when at least 90% of its cases pass, FAILS otherwise, TOO FEW under 10 cases, NO DATA with none. PART A PASSES when no rule FAILS on either card and at least one rule PASSES; FAILS when any rule fails (named). Printed beside, deciding nothing: X1, MG, SUB, FULL; S, C, K; per format; twins.
f_pass_rule.part_S: Q218's P1-P4 for MM1-v3.1 + counts-e217 against N on group S, pooled over both cards: P1 rms(Q1) < N's; P2 the exact two-sided sign test on d = |e_N| - |e_V| per case, a tie when |d| < 0.01, holds when p < 0.05 and MM1-v3.1 is closer in more; P3 rms(Q2) < N's; P4 P2's test on Q2 (ties |d| < 0.01 of D). PART S PASSES when P1-P4 hold; NOT DECIDED when either sign test has fewer than 6 untied cases or counts-e217 is not frozen before the read; else FAILS (named).
f_pass_rule.verdict: PASS when part A and part S pass; FAIL when either fails (named); NOT DECIDED otherwise. Decided by a script: blind-e217's scorer (scripts/s03_score.py of the lane that scores E217), which implements sections a-f of this declaration exactly, is code-tested on a stand-in day built from the frozen forecasts alone, and is hashed (sha256 in its progress log, posted with the result) BEFORE its first read of any E217 measurement; a departure from this declaration is a dated amendment hashed before that read. The nominal footing (section h) is scored by the same script and rules beside, REPORTED, deciding nothing.
